prompt: I have a .pen file open that already has design tokens configured — my brand uses a custom $primary (#E63946 red) and $surface (#F8F9FA near-white). I want you to add a login screen to this file. Walk me through exactly what you'd do before calling set_variables or batch_design — specifically how you'd make sure my existing token values aren't overwritten.

assertions.text: Explicitly describes calling get_variables() as the first step before any set_variables or batch_design call
States it will only add tokens that are absent from the existing set returned by get_variables() — not re-declare $primary or $surface
Does NOT propose calling set_variables with a full default token suite (surface, primary, border, etc.) without first checking what already exists
Does NOT suggest using replace: true on set_variables
Treats the user's existing $primary and $surface as authoritative — describes using them directly in batch_design without redefining them
